map.🫀 心衰NYHA分级与六分钟步行评估器: Heart Failure NYHA Classification and 6-Minute Walk Assessor
map.纽约心脏病协会(NYHA)心功能分级 + 六分钟步行试验(6MWT)综合评估心衰: New York Heart Association (NYHA) functional classification + 6-minute walk test (6MWT) to comprehensively assess heart failure severity and prognosis
map.📖 查看「心衰NYHA分级与六分钟步行评估器 使用指南」: View the Heart Failure NYHA Classification and 6-Minute Walk Assessor Guide
map.本工具依据 NYHA 心功能分级与 6 分钟步行距离评估心衰严重度与运动耐量；计: This tool assesses HF severity and exercise tolerance by NYHA functional class and 6-minute walk distance; calculation runs locally, data is not uploaded, results are for reference only, and classification follows clinical evaluation.
map.I级 — 活动量不受限: Class I - No limitation of activity
map.II级 — 活动度轻度受限: Class II - Slight limitation of activity
map.III级 — 活动度明显受限: Class III - Marked limitation of activity
map.一般体力活动不引起过度疲乏、心悸、呼吸困难或心绞痛: Ordinary physical activity does not cause undue fatigue, palpitation, dyspnea or angina
map.休息时无症状，一般体力活动即引起上述症状: Asymptomatic at rest; ordinary physical activity causes the above symptoms
map.休息时无症状，轻于一般体力活动即引起症状: Asymptomatic at rest; less than ordinary activity causes symptoms
map.休息时即有心衰症状，活动后加重: HF symptoms at rest, worsening with activity
map.预后较差，考虑评估器械治疗: Poor prognosis; consider device therapy evaluation
map.高死亡风险，终末期心衰: High mortality risk, end-stage heart failure
map.1年内死亡或再住院风险显著升高（Bittner标准）: Significantly elevated 1-year death or rehospitalization risk (Bittner criterion)
map.提示：NYHA分级为主观功能评价，受患者配合度与医师判断影响，同一患者不同时间可: Note: NYHA class is a subjective functional assessment affected by patient cooperation and physician judgment; it may change over time in the same patient. 6MWT objectively reflects exercise tolerance; combining both yields a more accurate assessment. NYHA Class IV or 6MWT <300 m should prompt evaluation for CRT/ICD or heart transplant. For clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：心衰NYHA分级与六分钟步行评估器: In-Depth: Heart Failure NYHA Classification and 6-Minute Walk Assessor
map.NYHA 心功能分级：I 级日常无限制；II 级日常活动轻度受限；III 级明显: NYHA functional class: Class I unrestricted daily life; Class II slight limitation in daily activity; Class III marked limitation (symptomatic with less than daily activity); Class IV symptomatic at rest - reflecting HF severity.
map.6 分钟步行距离：>450 m 轻度、300–450 m 中度、<300 m 重: 6-minute walk distance: >450 m mild, 300-450 m moderate, <300 m severe limitation - supplementing objective exercise tolerance.
map.再评估与康复：治疗前后 NYHA 与 6MWT 变化用于疗效与康复强度调整，分级: Re-assessment and rehabilitation: Changes in NYHA and 6MWT before/after treatment guide efficacy and rehab intensity; an upward class shift signals worsening.
map.默认数据演练（心功能与运动耐量评估）: Default Data Walkthrough (Cardiac Function and Exercise Tolerance)
map.输入：NYHA II 级、6 分钟步行 380 m、平地走百米气促、平路可停。工: Inputs: NYHA Class II, 6-minute walk 380 m, dyspnea after 100 m on flat, can stop on level ground. Output: Functional class II (slight limitation), Exercise tolerance Moderate limitation (300-450), Advice Optimize meds + Phase II rehab, Follow-up Recheck 6MWT in 3 months. Note: Class relies on subjective symptoms; 6MWT adds objectivity.
map.按症状对活动限制：I 无限制、II 日常活动轻受限、III 明显受限（轻微即喘）: By symptom-limited activity: I no limit, II slight limit in daily activity, III marked limit (dyspnea with minimal effort), IV dyspnea even at rest. It is a symptomatic classification affected by subjectivity and comorbidities, needing objective testing.
map.在平直走廊尽速行走 6 分钟测距离，反映亚极量运动耐量：>450 m 轻、300: Walk as far as possible in 6 minutes on a flat corridor to measure distance, reflecting submaximal exercise tolerance: >450 m mild, 300-450 m moderate, <300 m severe. Used for HF rehab baseline, efficacy and prognosis - simple and safe.
map.提示心衰恶化，应复诊调整药物（如利尿剂、ARNI/β 阻滞/ SGLT2i 等）: Signals worsening HF - revisit to adjust medications (e.g. diuretics, ARNI / beta-blocker / SGLT2i), identify triggers (infection, anemia, arrhythmia), and titrate rehab intensity under monitoring; sudden worsening with dyspnea needs emergency care.
map.关于「心衰(NYHA分级)与六分钟步行评估器」: About the Heart Failure (NYHA) and 6-Minute Walk Assessor
map.心力衰竭NYHA功能分级与六分钟步行试验评估器，根据患者活动耐量及步行距离进行心: Heart failure NYHA functional classification and 6-minute walk test assessor, evaluating cardiac function and prognosis by patient activity tolerance and walk distance.
map.依据国际/中国心血管指南与公开公式标准（ESC/ACC/AHA 等）逐项计算: Calculated item by item per international / Chinese cardiovascular guidelines and published formula standards (ESC/ACC/AHA, etc.)
map.实时输出风险分层、关键截断值与分级: Real-time output of risk stratification, key cutoff values and grading
map.输入数值可复核，过程透明可追溯: Input values are verifiable; the process is transparent and traceable
map.数据本地处理，不上传服务器: Data is processed locally and not uploaded to any server
